headline: Datiware Maritime AGM concludes with 100% voting support
summary: Datiware Maritime Infra Limited held its 34th AGM on September 24, 2026. All three resolutions, including financial adoption and director appointments, passed unanimously.

headline: Welspun Living shareholders approve FY26 dividend
summary: Welspun Living Limited held its 41st AGM virtually on September 24, 2026. Shareholders approved a dividend of Re. 0.10 per share and adopted financial statements for FY26.

headline: Canarys wins Rs 7.8 lakh cloud services order from Calibo
summary: Canarys Automations secured a confirmed order worth Rs 7.8 lakh from Calibo Inc for AWS and Azure support. The deal spans 12 months, adding to recent inflows from LinkedIn and GNIDA.

headline: Kay Cee Energy wins Rs 21.84 Cr RVPN order
summary: KCEIL secures Rs 21.84 crore maintenance contract from RVPN for Ajmer Zone. Order book coverage stands at 0.32 quarters. Negative operating cashflow persists in FY26.

headline: Agni Green Power wins Rs 9.14 Cr solar order from Govt of Mizoram
summary: Agni Green Power secured a Rs 9.14 crore work order for a 1.5 MWp solar plant in Mizoram. This adds to its Q1FY27 inflows, with the total disclosed order book covering ~18 quarters of TTM revenue.

headline: JSW Steel subsidiary files DRHP for IPO
summary: JSW One Platforms Limited filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI on September 24, 2026, for its initial public offering.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Waaree, Sterlite Tech, Nykaa, Lemon Tree in focus
summary: Waaree Energies eyes semiconductor gas entry; Sterlite Tech slips 5% on M&A head; Nykaa expands beauty portfolio; Lemon Tree adds Mumbai land.

headline: Steamhouse India wins ₹311 crore EPC deal in Himachal Pradesh
summary: Steamhouse India secured a ₹311 crore EPC contract for a 300 TPH steam and 30 MW co-generation facility in Himachal Pradesh.

headline: Usha Martin sells UM Cables to R R Kabel for ₹77 crore
summary: Usha Martin divests its U M Cables business to R R Kabel for ₹77 crore, sharpening its focus on its core wire and wire ropes segment.

headline: Vascon Engineers wins Rs 660.79 Cr order from Qualcomm
summary: Vascon Engineers secured a Rs 660.79 crore work order from Qualcomm India for an office facility in Bengaluru. The order boosts the backlog to Rs 868.56 Cr, covering 3.86 quarters of average revenue.

headline: Harsha Engineers to host investor meet in Ahmedabad
summary: Harsha Engineers International Ltd will hold a plant visit and group meeting for investors on September 30, 2026, in Ahmedabad. No price-sensitive info will be shared.
